scientific_integrity: The theorem is derived analytically; separate exhaustive finite tests and LP checks are corroboration only. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-seat, structured common/private/guardian approval profile; the frequency is within one instance over distinct labeled committees, not a random election model. Qualitative core-versus-priceability nonimplication is prior; density classification is the new claim.
title: An asymptotically vanishing fractional-core share among Pareto-efficient approval committees
